_about: Public-domain Henry Ustick Onderdonk (1789-1858), physician turned Episcopal Bishop of Pennsylvania, for the Word Hoard: The Rule of Faith, An Essay on Regeneration, Episcopacy Tested by Scripture (and Episcopacy Examined and Re-examined), The Atonement, and two sermons. His medical dissertation is left out. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 105 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

onderdonk-rule-of-faith: The rule of faith : a charge to the clergy of the Protestant Episcopal Church in the commonwealth of Pennsylvania, delivered in St. James' Church, Philadelphia, May 22, 1833, at the opening of the convention / by Henry U. Onderdonk (s.n., 1833)
onderdonk-regeneration: An essay on regeneration (Philadelphia : John C. Pechin, 1835)

onderdonk-atonement: The atonement : a charge to the clergy of the Protestant Episcopal Church in Pennsylvania : delivered in St. Andrew's Church, Philadelphia, May 16th, 1838 : at the opening of the Convention (Philadelphia : J. Harding, 1838)
onderdonk-christ-church-1841: A sermon delivered in Christ church, Philadelphia (Philadelphia, J. Crissy, printer, 1841)
onderdonk-refuge-in-god: Refuge in God : a sermon delivered in the Church of the Ascension, Philadelphia, on Sunday morning, October 26, 1856 / by the Right Rev. Henry U. Onderdonk (C. Sherman & Son, 1856)
onderdonk-episcopacy-tested: Episcopacy tested by Scripture (New York : The Protestant Episcopal tract society, 1860)
